title: AI Trading - Results - Day1
author: Fit-Maybe6858
selftext:
New here!

Need community to evaluate how my bot is doing. Test capital 5K with a target of $1000/day with focus on options!

What do you think on how it is doing?

comments.author: maddog107
comments.body: $1000/day??????? How much is it doing per trade? 2,500?

replies.author: Fit-Maybe6858
replies.body: Depends on the setup.. if A+ setup, it uses 50% of capital.. for A setup it uses 30%. Determines the targets T1, T2 and T3 and keeps trailing as it gets through..

replies.body: Uhm alright. Did you do backtesting? Was it good? What was the win rate and Sharpe?

replies.author: AdmirableJudgment784
replies.body:
Don't know why people downvote you. It's reasonable to not share something you worked hard on. It also makes total sense to have consistent results before you share/sell your work.

I have been burned before when I thought my bot has been consistent, but then a raging bull or bear day would wipe out gains. It really needs more of those days to allow the bots to capture data and learn from it.

comments.author: funeralbot
comments.body: So your agent tells you what options to pick and you pick them? Options are turned off for the agentic account. Also the MCP can see all your accounts, individual brokerage, roth IRA, and it's own agentic account. I have mine managing its own account and giving me guidance for options on my account.

replies.author: Fit-Maybe6858
replies.body: Agent does everything. Picks the option, places orders, decides targets, trails and books targets. Since its day1 i had to cut out the trade at target2. Agents exited 40% of position at Target 1. Need to fix that logic.
